title: Gem Cutter Library Profiles

reuse_decision.reason: Audit: the Cutters chapter had no cutter command at all. The M06 scallop builder (settings::bezel::build_scallop) sweeps one edge profile and the gem_pave azure curves are placement curves, so neither is a cutter body service. The M07 owner adds the cutter kernel once and the app dispatches to it; no second gem/settings store is created.
reuses: OM9-L2-04-14 (settings::head::GemGirdle, settings::bezel::ScallopParams for the shared gvBezelCutter)

previous_code_audit: crates/om9-app/src/menu_catalog.rs CUTTERS already lists BuilderGemCutter and BuilderGemCutterLibrary, but session.rs did not resolve, dispatch or prompt for either id.
crates/om9-app/src/display.rs CutterRecord { kind, seat } and CUTTER_EXTENSION_SLOT already existed, so the display filter expected a payload nobody wrote.
crates/om9-core/src/settings/bezel.rs owned BuilderBezelCutter (Scallop Bezel) with a swept edge profile; the Cutters chapter's dimensional controls were absent.
limitations: The ten presets are the manual's own table (Z in pavilion-depth units, radius in girdle-radius units); a user preset library is not part of this owner.
The library writes the same om9.cutter slot as the Gem Cutter with kind=gem_cutter_library, so the display filter and the jewelry report read one record shape.
